knowledge_point.title: Describing an Entry of a Matrix in Index Notation

question.:question/problem:
Consider the highlighted entry of the matrix $Y$ given below. Describe it in terms of $y_{ij}$.

$Y = \begin{bmatrix}3 & 9 & -9 & -6 \\ 2 & 1 & 4 & 8 \\ -8 & 2 & \boxed{4} & -6 \\ -3 & 4 & 8 & 1\end{bmatrix}$
question.:question/worked-solution: The entry lies at the intersection of the $3$rd row and $3$rd column. Hence, we have $y_{33}=4.$
